raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-BFA-EconomicOpportunitiesResilience",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Insecurity and active conflict in intervention areas could disrupt field operations, prevent face-to-face interactions, and impede implementation of economic inclusion activities.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy flexible adaptive implementation modalities including phone calls, radio-based messaging, third-party monitoring, and partnerships with local civil society and UN organizations.",
      "evidence": "high insecurity in some of the areas in which project activities will be conducted"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "The newly established PIU lacks pre-existing financial management staff, accounting software, and operational procedures, risking financial reporting errors and funds management delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit qualified financial management staff by effectiveness, acquire appropriate accounting software, prepare a financial procedures manual, and conduct regular external audits.",
      "evidence": "MFS currently does not have a PIU with FM arrangements in place, including the absence of FM staff"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Administrative routines and untrained bid committee members may cause significant procurement delays, impeding timely project execution and contract sign-off.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Recruit an experienced procurement specialist, establish defined processing timelines in the PIM, and provide continuous training on World Bank procurement procedures.",
      "evidence": "administrative routines may result in procurement delays, potentially affecting project implementation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Heightened vulnerability of target populations—particularly women and IDPs in conflict-affected areas—exposes beneficiaries to risks of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse, and Sexual Harassment.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prepare and implement an SEA/SH Action Plan, recruit a dedicated specialist, sign collaboration agreements with specialized NGOs, and establish confidential grievance pathways.",
      "evidence": "SEA/SH risk is Substantial, reflecting the nature of project activities and the vulnerability of the target population"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Fluid political situation in Burkina Faso could lead to institutional instability, policy shifts, or operational delays in project execution.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Maintain strong institutional anchorings through interministerial steering mechanisms and align operations directly with national flagship social protection programs.",
      "evidence": "the country's current fluid political situation"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Construction of 28 warehouses and rehabilitation of 10 provincial directorates could cause localized soil and water pollution and occupational health and safety hazards.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct environmental screening, prepare site-specific ESIAs and LMPs, recruit full-time environmental specialists, and enforce waste and worker safety protocols.",
      "evidence": "water and soil pollution from solid and liquid waste at construction and rehabilitation sites"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Land acquisition for warehouse construction and provincial intake center upgrades may cause involuntary economic displacement of local land users.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize secure public land, conduct social screening under ESS 5, and prepare and implement Resettlement Action Plans and Livelihood Restoration Plans as necessary.",
      "evidence": "economic displacement"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Fragmented social assistance implementation across more than 50 agencies and multiple line ministries may lead to operational coordination failures and overlapping mandates.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish an interministerial steering committee, set up inter-agency consultation frameworks, and use the Unique Social Registry (RSU) for unified beneficiary targeting.",
      "evidence": "Burkina Faso's social assistance system is highly fragmented, with more than 200 interventions implemented by 50 agencies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Procurement in fragile and insecure areas with a limited pool of local suppliers risks restricting market competition, inflating prices, and encouraging vendor collusion.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply World Bank procurement flexibilities for fragile situations, start procurement in accessible communes, and engage beneficiary technical departments early.",
      "evidence": "procurement in fragile areas with few bidders can restrict competition and possibly increase prices and collusion risks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Establishing interoperability between the social registry (RSU), payment platforms, and external partner systems creates cybersecurity and beneficiary data privacy vulnerabilities.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate security protocols from the National Cybersecurity Agency (ANSSI) and ensure full compliance with the Data Protection Authority (CIL) standards.",
      "evidence": "ensure proper and appropriate application of national data protection and privacy measures"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Vulnerable sub-groups such as female-headed households, IDPs, and persons with disabilities face structural barriers that could lead to exclusion from registry intake and project benefits.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate gender-sensitive and inclusive outreach criteria, conduct community validation, and implement an accessible Grievance Redress Mechanism.",
      "evidence": "exclusion from the project's benefits of certain categories of people such as vulnerable groups including women, youth, people with disabilities"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Severe climate events such as droughts or flooding could destroy productive assets of targeted poor households and disrupt project-supported livelihoods.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deliver climate adaptation training modules, support climate-resilient income-generating activities, and maintain a CERC component for emergency reallocation.",
      "evidence": "climate and disaster risk screening highlighted high exposure of project sites to climate and disaster risks"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Delays in fulfilling effectiveness and disbursement conditions—such as adopting the Productive Grants Manual—could stall financial flows to targeted beneficiaries.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Draft operational manuals during project preparation and accelerate execution of legal agreements and key staff recruitment.",
      "evidence": "no withdrawal shall be made for payments under Category (3) until and unless the Recipient has: (i) adopted the Productive Grants Manual"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Weak operational capacity or poor geographic coverage of contracted Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) could delay opening accounts and transferring productive grants.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct MFI mapping exercises, specify clear selection criteria in operational manuals, and utilize FundsChain technology and PDM surveys to monitor funds delivery.",
      "evidence": "The MFS will also partner with MFIs, which will deposit productive grants into the accounts"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Declining international humanitarian assistance funding could increase pressure on national social protection systems and exacerbate food insecurity among vulnerable populations.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Reinforce CONASUR logistically through new warehouses and vehicles, operationalize the HDP nexus, and expand national social protection coverage via the RSU.",
      "evidence": "significant decline in humanitarian assistance and funding since early 2025, prompting increased national ownership"
    }
  ]
}
